content:
name: Feature
about: Track a feature-sized outcome governed by a Work Packet.
title: "[Feature] "
body:
  - type: input
    id: feature
    attributes:
      label: Feature identifier
      placeholder: F-XXX-XX
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: input
    id: wp
    attributes:
      label: Work Packet
      placeholder: WP-MVP-XXXX
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: input
    id: parent
    attributes:
      label: Parent Epic
      placeholder: EPIC-XXX
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: textarea
    id: outcome
    attributes:
      label: Outcome and acceptance
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: textarea
    id: dependencies
    attributes:
      label: Dependencies and blockers
